paragraph: Highly sensitive plasma assays enable accurate blood-based biomarkers for neurodegenerative disease and provide minimally invasive options for clinical use. Large-scale studies encompassing multiple neurodegenerative diseases and utilizing multiplex platforms are essential to uncover disease-specific biomarkers and pathways. We generated and analyzed plasma proteomics using the NULISASeq
